entry.title: Updated: dsh-lark
entry.summary: Lark/Feishu bot channel for DeepSeek Harness: each chat drives its own agent, and tool approvals, model questions, and plan reviews return as cards answered by a button or a reply. Switch workspace and model from the chat (`/cd`, `/model`, `/new`), and run several bots that keep separate sessions and can hand turns to each other in one group. Exact install spec: dsh-lark-channel. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: sources.
